verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of any AI-model-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or privacy commitment regarding customer data being used to train AI models. CockroachDB Cloud does handle customer data and has AI-adjacent features (natural-language MCP interface), so the axis is a fair question for the product, but no documentation or community evidence addresses this specific privacy control. missing for 10: any documented policy on AI-training data usage, opt-out mechanism, or explicit privacy statement about model training.
